# the contributor audit: outward smoothing, singleton sources, and linked selectors

Source: `candidate 0fa64553cd01d7ae`.
Independent parity source: `candidate 54bd04196c016a99`.

PASS for the stated new attained variational interface, conditional on
the already audited compact original bad-sublevel and ordinary energy
inputs. No Gamma_d/k(P) payment follows from this audit alone.

## Compactness precedes uniform smoothing estimates

The outward kernel gives Q_h(N,c)>=mu{N.w>=c} pointwise. This passes
through both the cap infimum and mark supremum, so beta_(epsilon,h)
>=beta_epsilon^H>=beta_0 before normalization. Thus an actual strict
bad trial supplies minimizing sequences in the original compact bad
class. Only AFTER this reduction is the uniform O(h) slab comparison
used. This avoids the circularity of a symmetric kernel estimate whose
constant was known only on that compact class.

Covariance normalization preserves continuous affine maps and affine
base shears. Finite tilt clipping remains exact because the kernel is
constant outside a compact interval. The pseudoinverse argument bounds
a minimum-norm tilt representative using a finite fixed base row system.
Own-core interiority and sufficiently small epsilon,h make every active
kernel slab cross a fixed own ball; its positive section mass is uniform.
The pure-base gap is retained by a finite nonvertical tilt which loses
positive mass from its own zero-drift fiber.

## Parity and actual positive-width cover

the contributor independently proved the abstract interpolation argument in
`candidate f32b13bc6996e859`. Local strict decrease at one
attaining quantile is sufficient: monotonicity excludes any larger
threshold having equal or greater mass. Concavity then forces one
interpolated active cap to be active at every original source. Its
unrestricted base-normal derivative makes the SAME positive kernel
measure have two distinct base centroids, a contradiction.

This proves empty deepest-base hull and distinct parities at positive
width. Strict own H concavity also gives a unique mark per base. The
at-most-d+1 active normal selection and own concave tangent inequality
therefore construct actual singleton cover groups. Quantile equalization
uses positive S, and the finite off-source-base gap persists for each
fixed attained body. It is not necessary for that gap to be uniform in h.

## Exact response signs and constants

With Gamma(u)=1, q=(N.w-c)/h, S=int psi(q)/h, m=int w psi(q)/h,
and A=int q psi(q), direct differentiation gives

    dQ=-B(v)+m.nu-S r-A dGamma.

At a fixed marked source, differentiation of BOTH occurrences of Gamma
gives m_base/S=p and

    m_cont/S=y-[epsilon f-A/S] grad Gamma.

Thus the effective normal moment is m-A(0,grad Gamma), with the sign
used in the source. For inward body speed v,

    dGamma=(D-J)/(2M)+grad Gamma.dot u.

Combining this with the H response gives exactly the source's Xi_h:
the covariance coefficient is e_i rho_ij-omega_ij A_ij, and the global
constant includes +Abar/(2M). Since -hS<=A<=0, every added covariance
coefficient is nonnegative. The positive target density is

    B_*=beta+(d+2)Delta/(2dM)-Abar/(2M).

The same compact bounds give Delta=O(epsilon), |Abar|<=h S_max,
and a uniform O(h) boundary response correction. A lower Delta bound
uses the existing own-core lower bound on f and positive total kappa.
No width term is discarded at positive h.

Each singleton group response is linear. Finite separation followed by
compact finite intersection in the finite source-weight simplex yields
ONE separator for all physical fields and signed normal directions.
This step does not need the old outside-hinge branch space.

## Limits retain inside and outside body/section linkage

Boundary capture measures are dominated by actual surface measures;
normal-bundle convergence yields limiting densities in [0,1].
The vector Gauss--Green identity in the source has the correct factor:

    u int phi psi(q)/h
      =int_boundary phi Psi(q)n - int_body Psi(q) grad phi.

For an outside support the volume term vanishes, giving section density
W/|u|. For an inside support, subtracting the identity for the entire
body gives (1-W)/|u|. Thus outside body/section weights agree, whereas
inside weights sum to one. Proper cuts retain full section coarea.
These statements come from one actual sequence and do not require
O(h) Hausdorff displacement or an arbitrary subgradient selection.

Additional deepest bases may appear in the limit. The limiting stress
passes from the positive-width inequalities; the old singleton menus
are NOT asserted to cover those additional limiting deepest fibers.

## Uniform kernel and common roof

For Psi(t)=clamp(1+t,0,1), differentiating the cap integral is valid:
each kink plane has zero d-volume in each positive fiber, and dominated
convergence gives continuous first derivatives. Body differentiation
needs continuity, not differentiability, of Psi on the boundary.

On a fixed own facet all supporting section selectors use one concave
normal height profile plus affine corrections. With the uniform kernel
each is min(1,g_+) for a concave g. On its positive convex support it
is concave and is the height density of the convex set
{(X,t):0<=t<=1,t<=g(X)}. Compact convex lifts prove the stated L1
subsequential limit, including zero-volume limits.

The full ambient-facet version correctly retains sampled boundary bases:
it first takes compact patches within EACH own facet, uses fiberwise
Hausdorff convergence to define the common upper roof, and then uses
convexity on the convex hull of those patches. Ambient surface-nullity
does not discard any sampled fiber measure. Simultaneous limits of the
finite sampled lift traces preserve anchored Minkowski inclusion.

These are individual compatible selector lifts with shared provenance.
They are NOT yet a single bounded convex body whose ordinary halfspaces
realize the complete original cap menu: the common-roof representation
uses cap-dependent slabs and can require an unbounded lower floor.
That unresolved assembly is not supplied by compactness or this audit.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
